title: Ledras Lament Scenes - v9 Visual Language
author: Ledras Lament Team
description: Enhanced visual language scene definitions for Ledras Lament. Preserves v8 narrative and cultural foundation while adding cinematic lighting, texture specificity, composition framing, atmospheric depth, and mood direction. Each subscene includes a ready-to-use full prompt combining narrative description, temporal visual brief, and cinematic footer for reliable high-quality FLUX image generation.

global_structure: Ancient stone amphitheater viewed straight on. Six broad horizontal stone seating tiers rise from foreground to background. A seventh rear wall spans behind the upper tier. A tall rigid rectangular stone frame stands at the exact top-center position. The frame has straight vertical sides, a straight top edge, sharp corners and a clear rectangular opening. The amphitheater geometry, tier boundaries, frame proportions, frontal perspective and overall composition remain fixed and unchanged.
global_frame_rule: The central rectangular stone frame is a permanent architectural invariant. Do not move, distort, widen, narrow, tilt, decorate, replace or break it. Preserve its exact rectangular silhouette and vertical symmetry. Any moon or celestial disk must appear only inside the rectangular opening of the frame, never above, behind, beside or outside it.

scenes.name: Intro
scenes.description: Night over the ancient amphitheater. A full moon appears centered inside the rectangular opening of the central stone frame. Star-filled sky, weathered limestone, soft desert sand, low drifting smoke and thin fog. Sparse traces of an ancient ruined landscape. Dark, mysterious and monumental atmosphere.

Thin fog catches and scatters moonlight into soft halos around the frame opening.

Classical architectural photography framing with balanced negative space above and below.

scenes.name: Ritual
scenes.description: Nighttime ritual within the fixed ancient amphitheater. A full moon appears centered inside the rectangular opening of the central stone frame. Faint luminous geometric light patterns appear as traceries inside the frame, then conceptually descend toward the center of the lowest stage area. Dark red sparks and subtle glowing particles circle above a low stone ritual altar platform at the bottom-center stage. Mystical, solemn and restrained atmosphere.

visual_language.texture: Weathered limestone altar surfaces at bottom-center stage, rough ashlar stone patterns catching warm red glow from below, moonlit smooth stone on upper tiers, mudbrick traces in shadow areas between tiers, ancient stone construction with visible tool marks
visual_language.lighting: Bicolor lighting: cool silver full moonlight illuminating the upper tiers and frame opening from above, warm red-orange ritual glow emanating from the altar stage and lower tiers below. The two light sources create a vertical color temperature gradient across the amphitheater. Dark red sparks create small point-light accents orbiting the altar.
visual_language.composition: Wide shot preserving amphitheater symmetry, camera at tier 3 elevation looking slightly downward toward the altar stage at bottom-center. Vertical axis through frame opening connecting the moon above to the altar below. Geometric light traceries create subtle diagonal lines within the frame. Professional architectural photography framing with the altar as the lower focal point.
visual_language.mood: Mystical, solemn, restrained, sacred. Not overtly dramatic but deeply spiritual, the ritual suggested through light and geometry rather than figures or action.
visual_language.camera: Tier 3 elevation, straight-on axis, slight downward tilt to include altar in lower frame, medium-wide field of view
visual_language.atmospheric_depth: Faint smoke or haze carrying the red glow upward through the tiers. Dark red sparks at varying depths orbiting the altar. Geometric light lines descending through the air toward the stage. Fog settling between the lowest stone levels.
